name: 92604 · Irvine, CA
findings: ZIP 92604 (Irvine) has 149 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92604 (Irvine) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92604 (Irvine) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
